calibration.fit_on: 2020-2023 + 2026 seasons vs ESPN/consensus closing lines (2024-25 have no line data)

SPREAD.why: Only neutral-court spreads kept signal vs the closing line out of sample (2023+2026: 113 bets, +11.0% ROI, 95% CI -6.5% to +28.6%). Not proven; paper only.

TOTAL.why: No signal vs the closing total in any season since 2020 (shrink ~0).

staking.why: Flat $5 (1%) is primary: on the test bets it made +$62 with a $56 max drawdown vs +$39 / $83 for capped quarter Kelly. Never sized up after losses.

recalibration: Scheduled only: refit calibration + priors once in early January and once after the season, never after a bad day. Each refit gets a new version (ncaab_v2...) and old picks keep their version.
summary: Opponent-adjusted, possession-based efficiency ratings with a preseason prior (last season's ratings, returning minutes, transfers, conference), refit daily on games before tip. Every game's spread, total and moneyline is priced and logged; only neutral-court spreads with +2% calibrated EV are BETs. Totals and moneylines are tracked as WATCH/PASS because the backtest found no edge there.

home_court.why: Fixed instead of re-fit daily (early-season fit drifted to 3.6). Evidence: our model fit on full seasons 2023-2026 = 3.54/3.10/3.25/2.92 pts; average home margin in conference games 2023-2026 = 3.27/2.86/3.04/2.60; bookmakers use ~3.0 (VSiN, Feb 2025); KenPom market-implied 3.2-3.7 in 2014-2018 and trending down.

home_test.why: Nov 3, 2026 TEST lane: home-court spreads priced with the neutral-court calibration (as if the model were as informative at home as on neutral courts). The backtest says it is NOT (home shrink 0.046 vs 0.293), so this is a hypothesis to prove on the closing line. Separate ledger and bankroll; never touches the BET lane.
